description: Reminds Claude to append a TL;DR block to long replies, and checks the block is there and correctly formatted before the turn ends (the human:tldr skill).

hooks.command: echo 'When a reply runs past ~12 lines or ~150 words and is not mostly code, files or a table, invoke the human:tldr skill and end that reply with its TL;DR block, in the locked format the skill defines. Applies for the whole session.'
